fields.name: generate_type
fields.title: Generate Type
fields.description: Generation task type. Normal: textured model. Geometry: geometry-only white model (no textures). LowPoly/Sketch are not available in v3.1.

fields.name: enable_pbr
fields.title: Enable Pbr
fields.description: Enable PBR material generation (metallic, roughness, normal textures). Ignored when generate_type is Geometry.

fields.name: face_count
fields.title: Face Count
fields.description: Target polygon face count. Range: 40,000-1,500,000. Default: 500,000.
